The '''Strange Doll''' is an [[Artifacts|Artifact]] that can be found by digging up an [[Artifact Spot]] in many locations ([[The Farm]], the [[Bus Stop]], [[Pelican Town]], [[The Beach]], or [[Cindersap Forest]]), or in [[Fishing#Treasure Chests|Fishing Treasure Chests]] after reaching [[Fishing#Fishing Skill|Fishing level 2]]. It may also rarely be found by [[Hoes|tilling]] soil in [[The Mines]] or [[Skull Cavern]].  One Strange Doll (green) is always obtained after solving the secret in [[Secret Notes#Secret Note #17|Secret Note #17]].

==Donation==
Donation of this item contributes to the total count of donations for the [[Museum]].

==Tailoring==
The Strange Doll (green) is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[Tailoring|Wumbus Shirt]]. [[File:Shirt135.png|24px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a green dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Trivia==
*Both the Strange Dolls resemble characters in a series of webcomics called [http://wumbusworld.com/index.php?strip=1 Wumbus World], created by [[ConcernedApe]] in 2011. The green Strange Doll also resembles the [[Wumbus Statue]] and the protagonist of the film [[Movie Theater#Movies|Wumbus]], which are also references to the webcomic.
